# Where to Watch The Making of Angus Buchan


by Angel | October 15, 2026


You’ve seen Angus Buchan preach to crowds of hundreds of thousands, his voice ringing out with a resounding “Amen!” But what does his faith look like when the crowds are gone?


*The Making of Angus Buchan* offers a rare glimpse into the private life of one of the world’s most recognizable Christian voices. Through beautiful cinematography, an emotive original soundtrack, and intimate moments of reflection, the series explores the faith behind the public ministry.


[All three episodes of The Making of Angus Buchan are streaming now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/making-of-angus-buchan)


### **Beyond the Pulpit**


For many people, Angus Buchan is best known for his powerful preaching and the enormous gatherings where thousands come together to hear his message. His ministry has made him a familiar figure to audiences around the world.


But a public ministry only tells part of a person’s story.


*The Making of Angus Buchan* moves beyond the stage to reveal the man behind the message. Rather than focusing solely on the crowds or the public moments that have defined his ministry, the series offers a closer look at the person whose faith has shaped his life.


That shift in perspective is central to the docuseries. The Angus audiences recognize is still there, but the camera also follows him into quieter spaces, where his relationship with God takes center stage.


“It’s like he’s got a direct hotline to heaven.”


The series invites viewers to look beyond that public image and discover the faith that sustains him when no one else is watching.


### **The Beauty of a Life of Faith**


Beautiful cinematography and an emotive original soundtrack create an atmosphere that complements the series’ reflective tone. Rather than relying only on interviews or public appearances, the documentary invites viewers to spend time with Angus in the spaces where his faith is most personal.


The music adds emotional depth, while the visuals draw attention to the contrast between the scale of his public ministry and the quiet moments that sustain it.


Together, these elements make *The Making of Angus Buchan* more than a profile of a well-known preacher. It’s an exploration of the relationship between public influence and private devotion—and the ways a life of faith is formed over time.


### **What Does Authentic Faith Look Like?**


At its heart, *The Making of Angus Buchan* explores a question that extends beyond one person’s ministry: What does it mean to live an authentic faith?


Angus’s life offers one perspective. The crowds and the public preaching may be what people recognize first, but the series points toward the private practices and personal convictions behind those moments.


His story highlights the connection between belief and daily life, showing how faith can shape a person’s priorities, decisions, and sense of purpose.


It also offers a reminder that spiritual influence doesn’t begin on a stage. The quiet moments of prayer, the choices made away from public attention, and the commitment to follow God all play a part in shaping the person others eventually see.


Whether viewers already know Angus Buchan or are discovering his story for the first time, the docuseries offers an opportunity to reflect on what faithful obedience looks like in practice.


[Watch The Making of Angus Buchan on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/making-of-angus-buchan)
